text: Kaa ko hommbo waɗi leydi ndin ñiiɓundi tabitundi ndi yeƴodataa e ko woni kon e mayri, O waɗi e nder mayri canɗi ilooji, O waɗani ndi pelle tabituɗe, O waɗi hakkunde maaje ɗen ɗiɗi: Lammungo ngon e welungo ngon heedo haɗayngo jillondirgol lanɗanwo ngon e welungo ngon fii wata ngo bonnu ngoya, hara ngo moƴƴataa yarugol. Enee, ko reweteeɗo goo waɗi ɗum wonndude e Alla?! Wanaa non woniri, ko woni, ɓurɓe ɗuuɗude e maɓɓe ɓen ɓe Anndaa, sinndo hiɓe anndunoo ɓe sirkantaano Alla hay e gooto e tageefooji Makko ɗin.
